speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Weapon down. State your affiliation.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I woke up in an apartment. Is that an affiliation?

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Not if you can explain how you survived the breach.

speaker: NOVA
dialogue: Recommend honesty, selectively.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I can hear a voice. It says its name is NOVA.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: That is not possible. NOVA was decommissioned.

speaker: NOVA
dialogue: That is an inaccurate description of events.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Come with us. We can keep civilians safe.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I will come. But I decide who I help.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: We need people who can withstand the Fractures.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: You need soldiers. I am not one.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Then be something better. Make your own choice.

speaker: NOVA
dialogue: There are benefits to cooperating. There are also risks.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I am not signing away my life because the sky cracked.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Fair. Prove you can protect this district, and we talk again.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I will work with your team, but civilians come first.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Agreed. You answer to your conscience before you answer to me.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: I will help, but I am not joining your command.

speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
dialogue: Then prove that independence is not indifference.

speaker: NOVA
dialogue: Verdant Forest. The vegetation has absorbed Fracture energy.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: It looks peaceful.

speaker: SCOUT MIRA
dialogue: That is how it catches you off guard.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: You have been out here alone?

speaker: SCOUT MIRA
dialogue: Long enough to learn that the forest remembers footsteps.

speaker: NOVA
dialogue: Anomalous signal beneath the roots.

speaker: SCOUT MIRA
dialogue: Do not call every secret a target. Some deserve to stay hidden.

speaker: PLAYER
dialogue: We will look. We will not destroy what we do not understand.
